This ensures that the scroll bars are reset only when the window is opened, rather than every time an instance is retrieved.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications are related in that they both address the handling of the scroll bars in the `ObjectSelector` class. The removal of the scroll bar reset in the `getInstance` method prevents unnecessary jittering of the horizontal scroll bar while a model is running, which was a bug introduced in a previous commit. The addition of the reset logic in the `setVisible` method ensures that the scroll bars are only reset when the window is first displayed, thus maintaining a smoother user experience without the jittering effect. Overall, these changes work together to improve the functionality and user interface of the `ObjectSelector`.
